answer_1.quote: Given the inherent complexity of the presentation creation, there is growing interest in automating the presentation generation... In this work, we propose PPTAGENT, which addresses these challenges in two stages.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the presentation generation using the following metrics: • Success Rate (SR) evaluates the robustness... • Perplexity (PPL) measures the likelihood... • Rouge-L evaluates textual similarity... • FID measures the visual similarity... • PPTEVAL employs GPT-4o to evaluate presentation quality across three dimensions.

answer_3.quote: PPTEVAL employs GPT-4o to evaluate presentation quality across three dimensions: content, design, and coherence.

answer_4.quote: We recruited four graduate students ... to evaluate a total of 250 presentations... Following the evaluation framework proposed by PPTEVAL, assessments were conducted across three dimensions using the scoring criteria detailed in Appendix F.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators scored presentations across three dimensions (Content, Design, Coherence) using the PPTEVAL framework.
